verdicts.decision_note: The client requires the mint UI to disclose the sole supported currency or provide an ETH/USDC selector when both are available.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim for the agreed ETH/USDC payment-choice UI; the bounded preceding exchange resolves the reference to 'it'.
The client requires the unimplemented Card payment option to be non-selectable in the mint payment UI; no existing value key becomes obsolete.
This is the first concrete post-claim failure: ETH cannot be selected while the unavailable Card method remains selectable.
